El capitán del USS Seaviper debe desembarcar para realizar un reconocimiento en una isla cerca de Sumatra, pero el barco queda en manos de Mister Cutter, después de que el oficial ejecutivo resulta herido en batalla. Un conflicto entre Cutter y el jefe del barco pone al submarino en peligro. Seaviper está atrapado debajo de la superficie, con menos oxígeno, y un destructor japonés los caza desde arriba. Los daños sufridos por el barco también ponen en duda su supervivencia. Deben luchar contra el destructor japonés y llevar la información sobre el U-235 a Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Explore the fascinating history of exotic species in Texas, tracking how non-native wildlife populations have transformed the Lone Star landscape from early 20th-century introductions to today. The journey concludes at the historic Y.O. Ranch for an action-packed axis deer hunt in the Texas Hill Country.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Contributor Mark Kayser breaks down the whitetail rut and how you as a hunter can take advantage of the perfect timing.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: Rex meets up with “Mr Crappie” Wally Marshall in Texas. Wally takes Rex to one of his secret spots to put the hammer on the crappie. Not only did they catch crappie, but nice largemouth and some top tier coppernose bluegill.

programme.title: The Cast
programme.desc: The Crew heads to Rivers Lodge and Hunt Club in Kansas to fish strip pits. Trenton and Rex take on Mike and Nate in a 3 period mini tournament. With multiple species allowed including northern pike, the two teams are neck and neck after the first two periods. Due to bad weather on day 2, period 3 turned into a hour speed round where only keeper largemouth count.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: We listen to guides and anglers on how they attempt to hook into the migrating tarpon that pass thru PCB’s beautiful beach waters each summer. It’s a lesson in humility, respect and yes....luck.

programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: We listen to guides and anglers on how they attempt to hook into the migrating tarpon that pass thru PCB’s beautiful beach waters each summer. It’s a lesson in humility, respect and yes....luck.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Capt Justin says you can catch a redfish 365 days in Panama City Beach. We put those words to the test!

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: As part of this year's Star brite Sea Safe event, we hit the water to experience some of the incredible fishing the Indian River Lagoon has to offer. For Rush, that meant some serious bow time with close friend Alex Hughey - on the hunt for some of the biggest snook we've ever encountered. The bite wasn't easy, but that didn't stop Rush from smashing his personal best - not once, but twice - in one unforgettable day on the water. Don't miss this action-packed episode of the Sea Safe adventure from beautiful Sebastian, Florida!

programme.title: Super Retriever
programme.desc: The Open Division kicks off at the Super Retriever Series Crown Championship, in Shreveport Bossier CIty, Louisiana, featuring the sport’s most seasoned professional handlers and elite canine athletes. Competitors take on intense Retriever Trials and dynamic SRS Super Dock challenges, where experience and execution separate the best from the rest.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: The boys are still at the Raven in Missouri trying to finish planting 50 acres of Big Tine food plots in 5 days. Then Randy heads to the Powder River in Montana and tries to knock down his first buck of the 2025 season.

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: The boys are at the Dirty Bird in Oklahoma trying to run some trot lines on the North Canadian river but the water is just a little lower than they expected.

programme.title: The Raven Project

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.sub-title: "Raven Food Plots and Summer Work Part 2"
programme.desc: Randy is still at the Raven finishing up the Big Tine plots and hanging a new set of stands in hopes of killing a buck he has his eye on come fall.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Axis deer have always been an opportunity for Will Cooper—but never the main pursuit. In Chasing Spots, Will heads to Central Texas to hunt free-range Axis deer for the first time alongside good friend Casey Sanford. Hunting the opening of the Axis rut, the two battle summer heat, and cover miles of Texas Hill-Country.

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.sub-title: "THE LONG SEASON | Hunting an Elusive Kansas Buck"
programme.desc: Kansas doesn’t give up giants easily. After a tough early-season grind chasing Midwest whitetails, HuntStand’s Will Cooper left Kansas with unfinished business. But the season wasn’t over. In December, he returned to face brutal winds, bitter cold, long sits, and a mature Kansas buck that always seemed to stay one step ahead. What started as another trip to the Midwest quickly became a test of patience, persistence, and just how long you’re willing to stay in the game. Because some hunts come together fast. Others make you earn every second of them.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Season 4 of Hunting Land Man is starting off with a bang. In this episode, it’s opening week of turkey season in Mississippi, and these birds are doing it right. Cool mornings, gobbles breaking daylight, and longbeards fired up and on the move. We are fired up for the 2026 turkey season.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: On this episode of Hunting Land Man, Slade, Ryan and Bearcub take on the midwest! After some tough hunting, the group is able to make a move to get in position on a BIG midwestern gobbler! Bearcub was able to harvest him after working the bird for almost 45 minutes! Slade and Ryan also do some Pre-Deer season work, and establish where the fall food-plots will be!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Hunting Land Man keeps it rolling in the Mississippi woods. We’ve got some good buddies in camp this week, and it doesn’t take long for things to get interesting. One hunt ends in a tough miss, but we stay after it and bounce back with a longbeard hitting the dirt not long after. Later in the week, Slade’s wife Lori gets her first turkey of the year in an awesome hunt that came together just right. That’s just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: On this episode of Hunting Land Man, Slade does more summer food plot prep in hopes "Pope" will make an appearance! With Rain on the way Slade is able to disk and seed his "Pope" Summer spot!

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Returning to Venice, Louisiana for the first time in nearly a decade, Rush reconnects with longtime friends Eric and Monique Newman of Journey South Outfitters for an unforgettable inshore fishing adventure in the heart of the Mississippi River Delta. With reports of massive schools of redfish cruising the beaches, Monique (“Moe”) must decide whether to trust the intel and make a bold run down the coast—or rely on her own instincts built from years on the water. The mission is simple: put Rush on a true bull redfish and see if he has what it takes to earn a spot in her coveted “Over 40-Inch Club.” This trip highlights why Venice, Louisiana is considered one of the premier inshore fisheries in the country—and why having the right guide makes all the difference. Target Species: Bull Redfish. Location: Venice, Louisiana – Mississippi Delta. Outfitter: Journey South Outfitters.

programme.title: Séptimo Día

programme.title: Séptimo Día

programme.title: Séptimo Día

programme.title: El Rastro

Cuatro integrantes murieron, pero un niño de 11 años sobrevivió escondido bajo una cama, convirtiéndose en testigo clave. Aunque el motivo del ataque nunca se esclareció, las pruebas presentadas por la Fiscalía permitieron identificar a los responsables del crimen.

programme.title: El Rastro

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.sub-title: La niña de los sueños rotos

Días después, su cuerpo fue hallado en un cañaduzal. Testigos y evidencias llevaron a la captura de Cardona, quien confesó el crimen. Fue condenado a 50 años de prisión por homicidio agravado y acceso carnal violento contra su sobrina.

programme.title: El Rastro

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: A broke Josh is hired by a fearful man to help him elope with his sweetheart, Jane, the daughter of a local rancher. The girl's father is vehemently opposed to the marriage.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: Josh takes a job protecting an express office employee who stole $10,000 and wants to return it before it's discovered missing. However, he had an accomplice and does not know where the accomplice is.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive

programme.title: Dark Winds

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 opens in Joensuu, Finland in freezing -5°C conditions. Athletes battle frame carry as first event on ice and snow. programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025

The competition begins with a truck pull opener setting early times.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 heads to Zrenjanin, Serbia for Stage 3, where elite athletes compete in a packed city-centre showdown. programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 kicks off in Crema, Italy, for Stage 4 of the season, bringing a world-class lineup to Lombardy. Athletes face brutal tests including car deadlift, log lift medley, Hercules hold, and Atlas stones, as reigning champion Rayno Nel returns fresh from major victory to defend his crown.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Netherlands, for a high-stakes summer showdown. A world-class lineup, including Rayno Nel, Brian Kichton, and Evans Nana, battles in extreme 35°C heat across six brutal events such as truck pull, Viking press, and Atlas stones, as the fight for SCL glory intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Holland, for Stage 5 as athletes resume Day 2 of competition in a tight battle for the SCL title. programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League heads to Joensuu, Finland, for Stage 7 as athletes battle to be crowned the World’s Strongest Viking 2025. programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Esposende, Portugal, for the World’s Strongest Latino contest. Twelve elite athletes battle through a truck pull, deadlift, log lift, bag toss and medley in front of a packed crowd. Early leader Juan Ferrer sets the pace, as Invernizzi and others fight for top honours.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Farnborough, England, for the 2025 World Championship Truck Pull at the British Motor Show. programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Stage 10 of the Strongman Champions League 2025 arrives in Gdańsk, Poland, where a world-class lineup competes in tough events including deadlift, log lift, and loading race. With top athletes like Aivars Smaukstelis and Adam Roszkowski in action, the battle intensifies as the season nears its climax.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Siófok, Hungary, by Lake Balaton for a crucial late-season showdown. Reigning champion Adam Roszkowski returns to defend his title against a stacked field, including Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana. With World Finals approaching, the battle for points intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League makes its U.S. debut in Toledo, Ohio! In day 1 of 2, fourteen world-class athletes battle for the SCL USA title across four powerhouse events — including a Super Medley featuring a car push, Fingal’s Finger, and a stone-breaking challenge. Other highlights include the Front Hold with a whiskey barrel, a keg toss into water, and a gruelling 130,000 kg boat pull - capped off by an electrifying Guinness World Record attempt.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: It’s the final day of the Strongman Champions League’s first-ever U.S. event in Sandusky, Ohio. Athletes face a massive gas tanker truck pull, a unique shovel deadlift, and Atlas Stones weighing 120–200 kg - plus a thrilling Guinness World Record attempt. Who will claim the SCL USA crown?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Dubai for its penultimate stage before the World Finals. Elite athletes battle across gruelling events, including the dumbbell press, deadlift, and bag toss. With fierce competition and rankings on the line, every point counts in the race to qualify for South Africa.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League continues in Dubai for the final stage before the World Finals. Twelve elite athletes battle gruelling events near the Burj Khalifa, with Ramin Farajnejad leading after three rounds. With fierce competition and last chances to qualify, the stakes couldn’t be higher.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals begin in Uppington, South Africa, after a global season of elite competition. programme.title: Psychic Witness
programme.desc: In Illinois, a 16-year-old boy goes to speak with a contractor about a summer job. He tells his mother it'll only take a minute, but no one ever sees him again. Working with psychics Carol Broman and Dorothy Allison, police identify the kidnapper and discover he's killed many others. When two women are abducted and found stabbed to death outside Morristown, NJ, police believe they have a serial killer on their hands. Local psychic Nancy Orlen Weber works with detectives to try and catch him before he finds his next victim.

programme.title: Unscripted Paranormal
programme.desc: Adrian Lee and The International Paranormal Society wrap up their trip to Music Row in Nashville, Tennessee for an epic season finale. The investigation spans four iconic locations, starting at the graves of Keith Whitley and Johnny Cash, and ending with an exploration of the Nashville Musicians Association union hall and the world-famous Sound Emporium Studios.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Armando se enfrenta a Finita tras percatarse de la persecución de la cual esta lo hizo víctima tras haberla informado de su noviazgo con Natalia | Finita se despoja de su orgullo para exigirle a Armando la verdad de sus sentimientos hacia ella al creerlo incapaz de haberla dejado de amar tras haber vivido 10 años de un tórrido y apasionado romance clandestino | que la llevaba a ser infiel en su matrimonio con Botero | Armando le fija su posición a Finita al dar por terminado su largo romance.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Magdalena se encuentra en la clínica con Gabriel y lo ve muy triste, le pregunta si está todo bien. Angie le prohíbe a Brenda que vaya a la oficina con su hijo cuando no tenga donde dejarlo, a pesar de tener la autorización de Gabriel. Ana Belén le dice a Efraín que lo vio junto a Valentina la noche anterior. Magdalena le cuenta a Gabriel que Agustín está haciendo todo lo posible para sacarle todo y dejarla en la calle. Ana Belén le pregunta a Efraín desde cuando son amantes con Valentina. Magdalena le dice a Gabriel que es mejor que estén separados porque cada uno tiene sus problemas, sus temas y que la vida los cruzo tarde para poder tener algo juntos.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Elizabeth tiene una enfermedad grave y Cecilia busca curarla con hierbas para luego llevarla a Pedernales. Misael obtiene la custodia de Glorita, mientras Katiuska conspira con Renato contra Manuela. La tensión aumenta cuando Katiuska le roba a Candelaria una libreta con nombres de secuestradores y la quema, culpando a Hortensia y Benjamín para manipular a Ricardo. Finalmente, Cecilia se disculpa con Manuela tras un altercado con Jade, y Manuela decide mudarse a casa de Ricardo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Los malandros dan por muerto a Alejandro y vuelven a Caracas a cobrar. Alejandro sobrevive y es auxiliado por Severiano que cura su brazo con emplastos campesinos. Rosa convence a Eustoquio que el verdadero responsable de sus males es Erasto, no ella. Erasto engaña a Arminda prometiéndole su parte cuando aparezcan los papeles. Junior confiesa a Carlos que pierde la memoria. Consuelo se preocupa por la tardanza de Rosa. Rosa logra liberarse y toma un taxi a Caracas. Alejandro intuye que Rosalía lo traicionó al pensar quién sabía de su viaje. Rosa busca a Arminda exigiéndole la verdad sobre Eustoquio.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Alfredo Rosales muere en un accidente después de que Leoncio, mandado por Amada, cortara sus frenos. De esta manera, Luis Francisco se queda sin la información que el detective tenía para él sobre su hija. Alberta le dice a Benito que tendrán un hijo. Gina le pide ayuda a Braulio para conseguir un empleo, pero se siente decepcionada luego de que éste le sugiriera trabajar como empleada en un zoológico. Luego, ella amenaza a su madre con irse de su casa.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Ana termina dando el sí y se casa con Cristóbal, a pesar que Guillermo rezaba para que no aceptara. En la celebración, Guillermo al ser uno de los testigos es quién realiza el brindis en el cual no pierde oportunidad para dejar ver que su primo jugo sucio y por eso es que logró casarse con Ana. Durante la fiesta Ana se entera de parte de Fernando, el padre de Cristóbal, que Guillermo la noche anterior había dejado a Yenny. Ante tal noticia sale en busca de Guillermo quién le confirma que eso es verdad. Ana se enoja con él y le pide que le explique cómo es que ella se está enterando tan tarde.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Milagros pide hablar con Clemencia y Mayre le dice que no ha llegado, y en ese momento aparece Amada quien dice reconocer a Milagros. Mayre aclara que Amada tiene problemas con Clemencia y le aconseja a Milagros no involucrase en ellos. Vicky le anuncia a Enzo que está embarazada y Enzo sospecha de ella. Vick le dice que ese mismo día es la fiesta de su compromiso y conociendo su situación actual, debía ir. Enzo se dirige al laboratorio para verificar si realmente el examen es auténtico.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.sub-title: Episodio 24: Si lo ve, se muere...
programme.desc: Una vez finalizada la fiesta Cristóbal y Ana llegan a su habitación para pasar su noche de bodas pero se encuentran a los niños durmiendo en la cama de matrimonial. Esto termina con los planes de Cristóbal de pasar una noche ideal. Por otra parte Ana festeja el hecho de postergar la noche de bodas. Sin embargo continúa pensando en Guillermo, trata de auto convencerse que ahora es una mujer casada y sólo debe pensar en Cris-to-bal. Guillermo por otra parte se mantiene firme en la decisión de estar separado de Yenny. Sin embargo Yenny monta toda una escena para convencer a Guillermo que cambió y volver a estar juntos.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Gisela a pesar de saber del engaño de Atanasio evita un enfrentamiento con su esposo hasta lograr obtener las pruebas que la ayuden a confirmar su infidelidad. Yubiri conversa con Solimar al informar a su amiga de su molestia al haber descubierto a Wilker en una mentira mas por causa de la irrupción de Yelitza en su noviazgo | Graciela comparte la conversación de Yubiri mostrándose dispersa al enfocar sus pensamientos en Atanasio tras su romántico encuentro en el hotel.

programme.title: Till I Met You
programme.desc: Basti starts his new job to keep the money flowing as The Love Team continues to struggle with its negative image, while Iris and Ali try to close a deal with a potential client.

programme.title: A Love to Last
programme.desc: Realizing how his relationship with Andeng affected Chloe, Anton reassures her he won’t take their family for granted. At Betty and Jorge’s wedding, Anton endures the Agoncillos’ coldness. Meanwhile, Jenna asks Chloe a favor about Tupe.

programme.title: A Love to Last
programme.desc: Grace’s sudden return surprises Anton and Andeng. Still, Andeng helps Chloe with her debut preparations, though Grace insists on taking over. Meanwhile, Chloe ends her friendship with Tupe for Jenna’s sake.

programme.title: Ikaw Lang Ang Iibigin
programme.desc: While Bianca and Gabriel train in Batangas, Rigor claims his son’s allowance from Tiger Shark and runs into Roman, who confronts him about his past with Victoria. Victoria later faces trouble after learning of their exchange. Meanwhile, Lydia searches for answers, and Maila confronts Rigor about her robbery.

programme.title: Ikaw Lang Ang Iibigin
programme.desc: Maila visits the thrift shop where Rigor claimed he bought her wallet. Roman shares his suspicions with Carlos, who warns Victoria to stay away from Rigor. Still doubtful, Roman orders an investigation into Victoria and Rigor’s connection.

programme.desc: We discover why they call it Home Sweet Alabama with an inside peak in Huntsville! Featuring a behind the scenes look at the US Space & Rocket Center then we discover the haunted spots of downtown with a mysterious ghost walk, then ending the day with some famous Pecan Pie.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We explore Katonah, NY starting out the day with fresh farm & country at the Harvest Moon Orchard all while enjoying a local car show. We discover the history of Katonah from those who know it best and end our day with beautiful music at Caramoor.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.sub-title: The Neighborhood with Nicole: Bowling Green
programme.desc: We learn why Bowling Green is the corvette capital with a behind the scenes look at the world famous corvette museum! From there we zoom our way with corvette test drive on the race track and then head to some caves to explore the unknown. We end our day with some fresh made ice cream at Chaney's Dairy Barn.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.sub-title: The Neighborhood with Nicole: Outer Banks
programme.desc: We explore the Outer Banks. Starting the day out at the beach discovering wild horses. From there we go to the National Wright Brothers Monument where the first fliights took place. We top off our day visiting some historic lighthouse and some local cuisine.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We discover Franklin, TN also known to its locals for being voted as best small town in TN. Adventure starts our day, with a thrilling and beautiful ride showcasing the town views in a hot air balloon ride. From there we explore the history of downtown Franklin and end the day with some amazing southern cuisine.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We explore Hoboken and learn all about the charm of this famous neighborhood. Starting out the day with the "Mozzeralla Boss" we learn how to make mozzeralla from the king himself. From there we learn more about the history of Hoboken and its famous residents including the late Frank Sinatra. We end our day with art and fresh made delicacys.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.sub-title: The Neighborhood with Nicole: The Hamptons
programme.desc: We live like a local in The Hamptons. From paddle boarding the morning away to learning about art and history from the local experts we see everything the Hamptons has to offer. We top off the day with a classic float from the locals favorite spot.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.sub-title: The Neighborhood with Nicole: West Village
programme.desc: We explore the West Village in NYC, known to most as one of the most iconic neighborhoods in Manhattan. From sea salt cookies to handmade toys and collectibles we get to know the neighborhood first hand through its innovative locals and shops.

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: We enjoy a day to kayaking in this beautiful naval neighborhood. We learn first hand from local historians the rich history of Annapolis and of adventure in Annapolis. Starting out the day with some great eat from the famous Chick n' Ruths top off the day at the annual Crab Fest!

programme.title: The Neighborhood with Nicole
programme.desc: Lights, Camera, Broadway! We explore the VIP spots of Broadway and learn about how it all started. From a behind the scenes look at the famous Sardis to topping off the day at one of the citys most iconic cabaret spots!

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: This historic town northwest of Boston played a significant role in the American Revolutionary War. Come along as Nick explores the Minuteman National Historical Park, visits the Concord Museum, and takes a stroll through Authors Ridge, the resting place of famous authors such as Henry David Thoreau and Ralph Waldo Emerson. Discover the rich history of this charming New England town.

programme.title: Great Destinations Europe
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

programme.title: Follow Alana Switzerland

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On Thanksgiving Day 2013, the Hutson family’s celebration turned deadly when 19-year-old Rachel fatally shot her mother while her father was out shopping – and then texted her father a photo of her mother’s body. Rachel's lawyers say she had a history of mental illness that had gone undiagnosed for years. Did the added stress of caring for her ailing mother push her to snap? Or did she have a different motive? In an exclusive interview, will what caused her to commit this unthinkable crime finally be revealed? And, Rachel comes face-to-face with her family for the first time since she was sentenced.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jacob’s son Blake was burned at 2 1/2 years old on a treadmill in his sister Ellen’s home at Thanksgiving in 2014. Jacob claims Ellen was 100% responsible for his son’s injuries and scars. Jacob’s wife, Beth, says that their family was uninvited to further Thanksgivings by Ellen. Ellen says that she never uninvited Jacob and his family, is not responsible for Blake’s injuries and says that in the four-and-a-half years Jacob has held this grudge, Blake hasn’t developed scars. Ellen and Jacob’s brother, Ed, says that he’s tried to play mediator, but after Jacob went on a social media rant in February 2019, rehashing the accident and continuing to blame Ellen, he knew that this unhealthy family feud needed bigger help. Can Dr. Phil help these siblings mend fences? Also- Pfizer’s Chief Patient Officer, Dr. Freda Lewis-Hall, discusses what Americans need to know about rheumatoid arthritis.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mothers and their teenage daughters are rife for conflict under normal circumstances, but what happens when one party turns violent? Victoria wrote to Dr. Phil after she says her 18-year-old daughter, Jessica, physically attacked her on multiple occasions, leaving a gash in her head from a cellphone and her house damaged, as well as her body bruised after a Thanksgiving day family throw down. Victoria says she’s tried everything she can to help Jessica and she’s afraid her daughter is going to end up homeless, in jail, or dead without Dr. Phil’s help.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A desperate search for a missing 2-year-old boy in Texas, and a horrifying new discovery. Baby James’ family say they haven’t seen the toddler since Thanksgiving and claim his mother gave them a string of weak excuses when they asked where he was. In an exclusive interview, James’ great aunt says she feared something terrible had happened to the baby. She made a secret recording of her niece, the child’s mother, D’Lanny Chairez, who insisted that she placed her son for adoption. But James' great aunt says she wasn’t buying it, and when she went into D’Lanny’s home to search for James, she says what she found horrified her -- a terrible smell and a bloody blanket that police believe came from the baby’s crib. Was D’Lanny telling the truth about her son’s whereabouts? Don’t miss the shocking update.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Families fight – that’s a fact of life. For most, tempers flare, you make up and life goes on. For sisters Maggie and Marsha however, they haven’t spoken in two years, and the rift has their family trapped in the middle. See their emotional reunion as another sister caught in the crossfire brings the matter before Dr. Phil. Also on the show...they seem like the all-American family, but these two sisters feel their once solid family bond is a distant memory. Join one of them as she confesses to her parents her true feelings, and hear how she suppressed a devastating secret for years. Tune in as Dr. Phil gives them the tools to bridge their emotional divide.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Where there’s a will, there’s a war! Jay says he was betrayed and ripped off by his sister Carole. She says her brother owes her money from their father's estate. She wants him to pay up. But is their family feud really about the money? After more than three years without speaking to each other, the gloves come off! Then, Christy borrowed $100,000 from her mother but refuses to pay the money back until her mother kicks out the convicted sex offender she’s been living with.

Do you know the warning signs of someone who is at risk of developing an eating disorder? Parents, you can’t afford to miss this show!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his discussion with Meagan and her family. Meagan is a 26-year-old anorexic and bulimic who weighs only 73 pounds. She rules her house with her eating disorders, and her family is saying enough is enough. Will she give up control and accept help before it’s too late? And, get an update on Jennifer’s family. Three months ago, they sought Dr. Phil’s help for their daughter, who was battling anorexia and bulimia. How is Jennifer doing now? Her parents, Sue and Allan, and sister, Abbey, share with Meagan’s family what they’ve learned while Jennifer has been in treatment and how they can take their lives back and stop enabling the disease. Plus, test your knowledge of eating disorders. Would you recognize the warning signs?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Paul was his family’s rock and role model, so when he suddenly passed away, his wife and four children say their lives were shattered. Debbie, who was married to Paul for 30 years, says she shut down after his death and doesn’t know how to unite her brood. Sisters Jamie, Erica and Tayler say they don’t know how to properly grieve, they’re always fighting with each other, and they’re upset that their brother, Paul, turned his back on them. Paul says he didn’t run away from his loved ones; he has his own family and says he feels stretched thin. Find out the secret Erica’s been keeping that threatens to throw everyone into further turmoil, and hear the final wish Jamie’s dad had for her. If you’re grappling with grief after the loss of a relative, learn how to find closure and peace.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you're a parent having an extramarital affair " whether it's physical or emotional " should you tell your children? Or, if you're thinking about getting a divorce, how much should the kids know and when should they know it? Dr. Phil meets with a family torn apart over one parent's desire for a divorce.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Families fight – that’s a fact of life. For most, tempers flare, you make up and life goes on. For sisters Maggie and Marsha however, they haven’t spoken in two years, and the rift has their family trapped in the middle. See their emotional reunion as another sister caught in the crossfire brings the matter before Dr. Phil. Also on the show...they seem like the all-American family, but these two sisters feel their once solid family bond is a distant memory. Join one of them as she confesses to her parents her true feelings, and hear how she suppressed a devastating secret for years. Tune in as Dr. Phil gives them the tools to bridge their emotional divide.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you know people that can’t mind their own business? Dr. Phil’s first guest is fed up with her mother-in-law’s constant meddling in financial affairs, parenting, and even their intimate relations! So why does her husband frequently side with his parents? The friction mounts when members of this blended family speak out! Then, meet a 23-year-old woman who says her grandmother is smothering her. Can Dr. Phil help this dueling duo redefine their boundaries? Plus, find out how to deal with annoying backseat drivers before they drive you insane!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Everyone knows people that love to bicker. But what happens when the bickering escalates into verbal abuse and violence? Dr. Phil checks in with past guests Troy and Tammy whose explosive arguing is the primary dynamic in their marriage. Have they been able to break the cycle of drama or are they one step closer to divorce? Then—meet a single mother of five who worries that her children’s bickering may lead to fatal consequences! She thinks they’re out of control. So why is her daughter pointing the finger at her? Dr. Phil helps her end the fighting once and for all.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil revisits some of the most high-profile custody battles fought in the public eye. Model Bridget Marks is in the fight of her life after a court ordered her to turn her 4-year-old twin girls over to their father. Now, Dr. Phil gets her side of the story and what she plans to do next. And, when a mother decides she wants to move to Alaska with her kids, her ex-husband decides he’s going to fight her to the bitter end. Plus, a 12-year-old boy is caught between the grandmother who raised him and a mother desperate to reclaim him. Dr. Phil addresses the real casualties of these wars - the children - and talks about rules to live by when custody battles arise.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Where there’s a will, there’s a war! Jay says he was betrayed and ripped off by his sister Carole. She says her brother owes her money from their father's estate. She wants him to pay up. But is their family feud really about the money? After more than three years without speaking to each other, the gloves come off! Then, Christy borrowed $100,000 from her mother but refuses to pay the money back until her mother kicks out the convicted sex offender she’s been living with.

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E10 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Is the Honeymoon period over already? The rumor mill has it that Lisa (Eva Gabor) has packed up and left Oliver (Eddie Albert). Actually, she went back to New York to close up their penthouse apartment. And Mr. Haney is up to his old tricks!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) calls in a roofer, a plumber and agricultural expert Hank Kimball (Alvy Moore). All of them give the same appraisal of his farm: it's a disaster! Meanwhile, Mr. Haney (Pat Buttram) has a few chickens he'd like to rent out!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The Douglases are awaiting the arrival of their furniture and they don't know it, but Oliver's mother is on her way, too. But when the furniture is accidentally delivered to Mr. Haney's new place, he tries to sell their own possession back to them.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Planting season ends in three weeks and Oliver has yet to get his land plowed. Meanwhile, Uncle Joe (Edgar Buchanan) needs a new shotgun before duck hunting season starts and schemes to solve both of their problems...without Oliver knowing it.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver (Eddie Albert) sends a sample of his soil to the State Scientific College, a report comes back that his farm contains ingredients never before found in soil. Could his soil problems just be cosmetic? Eleanor Audley guest stars.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: You Can't Plug In A 2 With A 6
programme.desc: Relying on statistics provided by the Department of Agriculture, Oliver (Eddie Albert) decides to plant wheat. But when he goes to Drucker's to buy seed, he learns the other farmers have a unique way to predict the best crop�Mrs. Ziffel's lumbago.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Don't Call Us, We'll Call You
programme.desc: After some wheeling and dealing and mending a riff between Mr. Kimball and his mother, Oliver (Eddie Albert) finally has a phone installed, but the Hooterville Phone Company installs it directly outside his bedroom window...on top of the phone pole.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) plants his entire 160 acres with wheat, only to hear from The Crabwell Corners Conservation and Stabilization Committee, a local farm organization, that he was only permitted to grow eight acres of wheat�because of Mr. Haney.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The cow that Oliver (Eddie Albert) bought from Mr. Haney is pregnant. Afraid that Haney will claim the new calf, Oliver and Eb decide to keep it secret...only to have the people of Hooterville think that it is Lisa (Eva Gabor) who is expecting!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's the Douglases' wedding anniversary and, after initially pretending not to remember, Oliver (Eddie Albert) makes clear that he knows the date very well, he just can't remember exactly how many years he and Lisa (Eva Gabor) have been married.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is shocked that Hooterville has no beauty parlor, and the Ladies' Every-Other-Wednesday Afternoon-Discussion-Club nominates her to make it happen. Of course, Oliver's mother is happy to help, even if it means underhanded tactics.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Give Me Land, Lots Of Land
programme.desc: When Oliver's neighbor, Mr. Watson, decides to do some traveling, Oliver (Eddie Albert) buys the farm which adjoins his property, but not the house on it. Lisa (Eva Gabor) misunderstands and thinks the beautiful farmhouse is their new home.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: I Didn't Raise My Husband To Be A Fireman
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers the only requirement to join the Hooterville Valley Fire Department is that he must play a musical instrument. Meanwhile Lisa (Eva Gabor) tries her hand at cooking something besides "hotscakes" for breakfast.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Believing he will never get a moment's peace, Oliver (Eddie Albert) is annoyed when Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts a listing in the new phone book: "Oliver Douglas, Attorney at Law"�but it is a different story when no one calls for his services.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert)'s apple crop is ready to be harvested, and he decides to take them to market himself and make a killing. Of course, getting to market before the price drops proves a little more difficult than Oliver anticipates.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) becomes enamored of Mr. Kimball (Alvy Moore), the county agent. However, though she feminizes herself and gets all gussied up, he refuses to go out with a girl named Ralph. Can Oliver solve the situation legally?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Six months is up! Now, Lisa (Eva Gabor) gets to decide whether she and Oliver (Eddie Albert) will remain on the farm or go back to New York and their Park Avenue lifestyle! Will this be the final straw for Green Acres?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Sam Drucker (Frank Cady) is leaving on a much-needed two-week vacation and talks Oliver (Eddie Albert) into assuming his duties as deputy sheriff. But Oliver soon learns enforcing the law isn't quite as easy as it looks.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Whatever you do, don't say her name and especially while playing checkers down at Drucker's! An old hag named Molly Turgiss (Renie Riano), who died twenty years before the Douglases (Eddie Albert, Eva Gabor) came to town, might be haunting them.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Never Look A Gift Tractor In The Mouth
programme.desc: It's a few days before Oliver (Eddie Albert)'s birthday, and Lisa (Eva Gabor) doesn't know quite what to get him�until the old Hoyt Clagwell goes kerflooey! So, she goes out and buys the biggest and fanciest tractor she can find.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Eb (Tom Lester) has a way with sick animals after Eb cures Arnold, the pig, and Alice, the chicken, and offers to put him through veterinary college. But will life in Green Acres ever be the same without Ed?!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: A horse follows Oliver (Eddie Albert) home, but every time he tries to show it to his wife, the horse disappears. Lisa (Eva Gabor) assumes that her husband is imagining things�and as more animals show up, Oliver begins to think so too.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Mr. Haney (Pat Buttram) takes Oliver (Eddie Albert) to Pixley Superior Municipal Court and sues him for non-payment of a vital contract over the little matter of some rain�or lack thereof. Does Mr. Haney know who he's up against? Does Oliver?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The Third-Tuesday-of-Every-Month-Culture-Committee of the Every-Other-Wednesday-Afternoon-Discussion-Club decides that Hooterville needs some "culture" in the form of a symphony orchestra. And Lisa (Eva Gabor) may just know the perfect conductor.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver's (Eddie Albert) nephew Charles (Don Edmonds) arrives for a visit, and Oliver is completely shaken up when the boy turns out to be a long-haired, motorcycle-ridin', hippy-dippy type. But, boy, does he know a thing or two about engines.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver dreams of entering his crop in the Corn Festival, but the dreaded "Bing Bug" invades Hooterville's farms. After learning of his service as a WWII pilot, the locals volunteer him for the perilous task of flying the town's only crop duster.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: How To See South America By Bus
programme.desc: When a lovely, young and successful farmer comes to Oliver (Eddie Albert) for his legal counsel, Lisa (Eva Gabor) quickly becomes jealous of the two spending time together and becomes determined to break up what she sees as a budding romance.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When the Monroe Brothers show up to fix the Douglas's closet, Lisa learns that Ralph is devastated because her true love has stood her up on another date. Lisa's solution: an intensive, two-day beauty treatment for Ralph�and the barn for Oliver!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: One Of Our Assemblymen Is Missing
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) takes to his soap box, delivering fiery, patriotic speeches after getting a bill from the State Farm Unattached Duty Tax for an outrageous $12.03! But no one can figure out why the tax is levied in the first place.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa (Eva Gabor) is curious to learn about the book that Oliver (Eddie Albert) is reading. It is the "real-life" story of pioneers Gus and Etta Thompson. The episode flashes back to the 19th century with Oliver appearing as Gus and Lisa as Etta.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Eb Discovers The Birds And The Bees
programme.desc: Eb (Tom Lester) seeks dating advice from the Douglas's after laying eyes on former classmate Betty Jo Bradley from "petticoat Junction." Oliver's well-intentioned guidance has mixed results when Eb hilariously misconstrues the advice he's given.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: The locals complain that Oliver's penchant for wearing business suits to do farm work is ruining Hooterville's image. Oliver tries to adjust, but the last laugh is on him when Lisa has her dressmaker design Italian him some swanky new overalls.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: You Ought To Be In Pictures
programme.desc: The Hooterville Chamber of Commerce attempts to attract a Hollywood film studio to shoot a movie in town. And when a rumor spreads that famous actor is arriving, the townsfolk are all abuzz as they prepare for their close-up, Mr. DeMille!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: A Home Isn't Built In A Day
programme.desc: Fed up with the house being in dire need of repair, Lisa demands that Oliver arrange to have the house redone or she's moving back to New York. Oliver agrees, but is delayed when Mr. Haney claims that their farmhouse is a historic monument.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Everything is topsy-turvy and henhouse hijinks ensue when one of the Douglas' hens is found to be laying square eggs! News of this kind gets around quickly, and the townsfolk all get in on the race to capitalize on the impressive novelty.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver is absolutely determined to have a truly old-fashioned Christmas, including decorating his own farm-grown tree. But warm weather stands in the way and, he discovers, the residents of Hooterville aren't exactly as traditional as he thought.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Never Trust A Little Old Lady
programme.desc: In true Hooterville fashion, Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that the town is vehemently split as to which weather reporter they trust. As debates rage over which forecast is correct, Oliver plants his tomato crop, hoping for the best.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After another disastrous effort from Lisa in the kitchen, Oliver implores her to take a home economics class at the local high school. Before she knows it, Lisa is a fully enrolled student...the likes of which Hooterville High has never quite seen.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When the Hooterville City Council appoints Oliver (Eddie Albert) to judge the apple competition at the annual fair, he mistakes the honor for a real judgeship and prepares for his time on the bench! But a run-in with the real law clarifies matters.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: It's So Peaceful In The Country
programme.desc: Lisa visits Oliver's mother who is recovering from an illness. The doctor advises that she rest in a peaceful environment...and thinks that Hooterville sounds absolutely ideal! Of course, he doesn't know Hooterville, where peace is never�very close.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Hooterville has a still-valid contract to build war planes, he spearheads the opening of new government defense plant. But as chaos ensues, Oliver soon wonders if the move was a big mistake after all.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa is appointed as head of Hooterville's new "Human Humane" committee. A perfect fit for animal-lover Lisa, and a relief from her boredom in the countryside, she soon has a menagerie of both farm and exotic animals living at Green Acres.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.sub-title: Never Take Your Wife To A Convention
programme.desc: Oliver takes Lisa along to an agricultural convention. There, Lisa bonds with an ex-gangster couple, who insist upon teaching the Douglas's some of their shortcuts to successful farming. It turns out to be an offer that Oliver can not refuse.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Oliver champions agri-tech as way to increase productivity on the farm, but when a computer gives its assessment of the Douglas' marriage, Lisa (Eva Gabor) begins to question her union with Oliver. It's bits versus bytes in Green Acres!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Determined to teach his spendthrift wife Lisa how to save money, Oliver insists that she learn about farming...by growing her own vegetables! In her own inimitable fashion, armed with useless pamphlets from Mr. Kimball, Lisa sets to tilling!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: When handyman Eb (Tom Lester) reports he has seen little green men piloting flying saucers, everyone in Hooterville takes him at his word�even the Air Force�and soon the Douglas farm becomes the Roswell of the greater Pixley area!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) is distraught when her beloved Mr. Kimball, is fired as the county agricultural agent. Out of a job, Kimball (Alvy Moore) no longer has money enough to marry the lady-carpenter-in-waiting! But wait�did he even want to?

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Lisa weaves the tale of her great, great grandmother, the Queen of the Gypsies, to explain a bizarre family tradition: a woman in her family must marry an American -- but only every fourth generation -- in order to gain a special inheritance.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: After Oliver (Eddie Albert) accidentally drops a hammer on her head, Lisa (Eva Gabor) develops a case amnesia, with no idea who she is or why she is on a farm in Hooterville�and she adamantly refuses to believe that Oliver is her husband!

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: Nothing gets done on the Douglas farm when Oliver (Eddie Albert) gifts Eb (Tom Lester) a top-of-the-line radio for his birthday. Letting nothing stop him, Eb (Tom Lester) enters a radio contest...even when Eleanor the cow swallows the radio whole.
